build.localReleaseOverride: Digi Mono compiled from the recorded Modwerk source; dependency pins come from the catalog. The stock-free exported package and private materialized recipe produce byte-identical firmware.

emulator.framebuffer: firmware front LCD buffer at panel_diff flush
emulator.frameSelection: Most populated actual LCD frame within the final 250 ms after the latest panel action; 6x integer scaling.

setup.project: Disposable first-boot A01, stock initial track state; no owner projects or samples.
setup.fixture: No sample fixture required for the documented UI pages.
setup.sandbox: No network; user files denied; private temporary output only.
